<!--
Title format (required):
  type(scope): short description

Examples:
  feat(bus): add cross-tab message batching
  fix(core): prevent duplicate listener registration
  docs(readme): clarify BroadcastChannel fallback
-->

## Summary
- What does this PR do in one or two sentences?

## Changes
- Key technical changes and why they’re needed.

## Motivation & Context
- Problem this solves, links to issues if any.

## Testing
- How you verified the change (commands, scenarios, edge cases).

## Screenshots / Demos (optional)
- If applicable, attach screenshots or GIFs.

## Breaking Changes
- Any breaking behavior? If yes, describe migration steps.

## Checklist
- [ ] Title follows `type(scope): short description`
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`npm test`)
- [ ] Type checks pass (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Docs updated (if needed)
